research_question: Owner-approved addition: ZenBusiness Reviews: Plans, Renewal Costs, and Best Fit. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for zenbusiness reviews, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Small-business owners, founders, and consumers in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; Starter's free year of Worry-Free Compliance renewing at $199 added; website builder trial corrected to be preselected on Starter and listed across packages; rush processing ($79) added; Harbor Compliance comparison corrected to $99 then $159; 'lifetime document access' wording replaced with the page's 'dashboard with unlimited storage'; Money Pro limited to Pro and Premium.
